scripts.build: npm run build -w dashboard && npm run build -w worker
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run check:agent
scripts.check:agent: cd agent && test -z "$(gofmt -l .)" && go vet ./... && go run ./tools/fetchccusage && CCUNIFIED_REQUIRE_CCUSAGE=1 go test ./...
scripts.demo: npm run build -w dashboard && node worker/scripts/demo.mjs
scripts.test:browser: npm run build -w dashboard && npm run test:browser -w e2e
